# Paladin spells

38 spells · 5 levels · source: SRD D&D 2024

The Paladin spell list (`class:paladin`), by level, then name.
C/R/M: Concentration, Ritual, Material component (`-` = no). `Reaction*`: a reaction with a trigger (see the spell).
